text: The digital archive saved me weeks of work.
Excellent collection, and the search is fast and easy.
I finally found the letter I was looking for. Wonderful!
The scans are clear and the catalogue is very well organised.
The search is slow and the results are inaccurate.
Half of the pages will not load, and nobody answers emails.
The scans are so blurry that the text cannot be read.
Very disappointing, most of the material is not available online.
New manuscripts were uploaded on Sunday.
The reading room is open from nine to five.
The website has one section for newspapers and one for maps.
The centre will hold a workshop on cataloguing next week.
